setup.faq.permissions.a: In this workspace: a read-only account can read this page, changing settings needs an account that can write, and only an administrator can verify the model. In the cloud: an account's role needs read access for scanning and diagnosis; it needs write access only for what you want agents to execute.
setup.faq.again.q: How do I get back here later?
setup.faq.again.a: «Setup overview» is in the account menu and at the top of Settings; the address is /app/setup.
setup.faq.done.a: When cloud accounts read «Connected» and the model reads «Verified», you can start a first task. Execution and approval are yours to decide; notifications can wait.

settings.high.auto_fix_enabled.desc: After a diagnosis it goes on by itself: writes the plan, then approves and runs it as the switches below allow.
settings.high.auto_fix_enabled.affects: planning after a diagnosis, auto-approval, the run that follows an approval.
settings.high.auto_fix_enabled.onMeans: On: an issue whose diagnosis passes the quality gate gets a plan by itself.
settings.high.auto_fix_enabled.offMeans: Off: every step waits for a person; approving a fix plan does not run it.
settings.high.executor_enabled.affects: the runs of fix plans and changes.
settings.high.executor_enabled.offMeans: Off: no new run starts; an approval is only an approval.
settings.high.executor_auto_approve_l0_l: Low-risk (L0) and minor (L1) fix plans are approved without a person.
the approval of fix plans. A plan with a step the code cannot classify, or one redone after a person's «no», always waits for a person.
On: such plans are approved before anyone has read them (while the auto-fix pipeline is on too).
Off: every fix plan waits for a person.
settings.high.executor_hitl_enabled.desc: Before each operation that is not on its short list of read tools, the executor stops for a person's confirmation. This version has no place to give that confirmation yet: with it on, a run stops at its first such step and ends without a result.
settings.high.executor_hitl_enabled.affe: every run of the executor. It takes effect from the next executor run; a run in progress is not affected.
settings.high.executor_hitl_enabled.onMe: On: a run stops at its first such step and ends as failed — nothing is changed, and the plan's approval is spent. Today this only holds every run back.
settings.high.executor_hitl_enabled.offM: Off: an approved plan runs step by step without asking again.
settings.high.change_auto_approve_standa: A change request the policy rules as «standard» is approved without a person.
the approval of change requests (when the policy rule and this switch both agree).
On: a standard change is approved and run before anyone has read it.
Off: every change waits for a person.
settings.high.rbac_enforce.desc: While off, an action the permission rules deny is only recorded and still allowed.
settings.high.rbac_enforce.affects: every action that needs a permission: approving, running, accepting, notes …
settings.high.rbac_enforce.onMeans: On: an action the rules deny is refused (403).
settings.high.rbac_enforce.offMeans: Off: recorded, not blocked. The few rules marked «always» still block.
